ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of Medicaid fraud cases, identifying patterns and connections between entities and programs.
questions: What are the most common schemes used in Medicaid fraud?
How do fraudsters launder their illicit gains?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial aspects of Medicaid fraud, we may uncover new leads and connections between entities, ultimately helping to prevent future fraud.
